name: GPU Voxelizer using Nearest Vertex and Normal Dot Product
definition: A real-time voxelization technique that determines if a voxel is inside, on the edge, or outside a mesh by finding the nearest vertex on the mesh for each voxel and using the dot product between the ray from the vertex to the voxel and the vertex normal to determine interiority.
summary: A brute-force GPU voxelizer that determines voxel interiority by checking the dot product between the nearest vertex normal and the voxel vector, avoiding rasterization entirely.
